findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the silicone sealant between the prep table and wall to be damaged and soiled. The prep table is not bolted in place, and therefore can be moved for cleaning. As long as the table can be pulled from the wall for adequate cleaning, silicone sealant is not required between the table and wall. Ensure the damaged/soiled silicone is removed or replaced prior to the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water properly disposed.
findings.comment: Inspector observed a wastewater leak from underneath the right basin of the triple sink. A leak or ponding water was not observed at the start of the inspection. The leak seems to have occurred during the inspection. The PIC was notified of the leak and the triple sink was drained. The dish machine in the facility is currently under maintenance, so the triple sink is the facility's sole method of washing and sanitizing. The accommodate their needs, the right basin will be converted to the “rinse” basin with no water held. The facility will wash in the left basin, rinse with running water in the right basin, and sanitize in the center. This is a temporary solution until the sink can be repaired. If the leak worsens and the sink cannot be used at all, the facility has large bins that can be utilized as a temporary triple sink. Staff is educated on preparing temporary washing/sanitizing systems. A follow-up will be conducted on Friday, February 6th to ensure the sink has been repaired.
findings.citation_text: 5-402.13 Conveying Sewage. SEWAGE shall be conveyed to the point of disposal through an APPROVED sanitary SEWAGE system or other system, including use of SEWAGE transport vehicles, waste retention tanks, pumps, pipes, hoses, and connections that are constructed, maintained, and operated according to LAW.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
The following facility items are in need of repair:

1. The cove base under the triple sink is peeling from the wall. Ensure floor/wall junctions are sealed to prevent moisture damage or mold accumulation.

2. The sealant between the triple sink and the wall was observed soiled and damaged. The sealant (typically silicone) needs to be removed and replaced.

Ensure these facility repairs are completed by the next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.comment: Inspector observed boxes of pasta and apples stored directly on the floor in the dry storage area of the kitchen. The PIC was informed, and the items were moved off the floor. Ensure food items are stored a minimum of 6 inches off the floor to prevent contamination from pests or floor cleaning chemicals.
findings.citation_text: 3-305.11(A) Food Storage. (A) Except as specified in (B) and (C) of this section, FOOD shall be protected from contamination by storing the FOOD: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where it is not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Observed inadequate handwashing between glove/task changes. Educated PIC that hands must be washed before donning new gloves or before starting a new task. Ensure hands are washed effectively and frequently to avoid cross-contamination with food and food contact surfaces.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.14 When to Wash. FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms as specified under § 2-301.12 immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including working with exposed FOOD, clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, and unwrapped SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and: Before donning gloves to initiate a task that involves working with FOOD; and (I) After engaging in other activities that contaminate the hands.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed can opener blade to be soiled with dust and debris. Informed PIC that can opener should be cleaned after each use or a minimum of every 4 hours. PIC moved can opener to dishwashing area after being informed that it was soiled. Ensure blade is cleaned effectively and frequently to avoid cross-contamination with food and food contact surfaces.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Single use/single service articles are properly stored and used.
findings.comment: Observed packages of single-use forks and spoons to be left open with no adequate covering in dry storage. Informed PIC that packages should be closed between uses to avoid dust or other debris from falling into the package and contaminating food contact surfaces. PIC closed containers. Violation is considered COS.
findings.citation_text: 4-903.11(A) Equipment, Utensils, Linens, and Single-Service and Single-Use Articles. (A) Except as specified in (D) of this section, cleaned EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, laundered LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be stored: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
Observed shelving used to store clean dish ware to be rusting in several areas. Replace shelving. 

4-101.19: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other FOOD soiling or that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a CORROSION-RESISTANT, nonabsorbent, and SMOOTH material.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed floors underneath shelves, coolers and freezers in dry storage and main kitchen room to be soiled with food debris. Clean floors in dry storage room. 

6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used
findings.comment:
Observed employee cell phone, phone charger and glasses on food contact surface in kitchen. Items were moved during inspection. 

6-403.11: (A) Areas designated for EMPLOYEES to eat, drink, and use tobacco shall be located so that FOOD, EQUIPMENT, LINENS, and SINGLESERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES are protected from contamination. (B) Lockers or other suitable facilities shall be located in a designated room or area where contamination of FOOD, EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS, LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES cannot occur.
